assumptions.statement: The repository provisional SITE_BOUNDARY and three KEY_AREA polygons are used only for concept generation, visualization and intake checks.
assumptions.impact: All geometry-derived ratios and locations must be recomputed after official polygons arrive.

assumptions.statement: FAR, building height, density, setbacks, roads, utilities, fire, flood and heritage controls are absent.
assumptions.impact: No statutory or engineering conclusion is made.

assumptions.statement: Existing buildings, schools, public facilities, ownership, population and child-service baselines are absent.
assumptions.impact: Question yards and stops are spatial types, not parcel-level siting or demolition decisions.

assumptions.statement: No child consultation was conducted in this AI-generated round.
assumptions.impact: A child observation group, caregivers, disability representatives and professional teams must test and revise the proposal before implementation.
